facts.text: Jon expresses that dancing is second nature to him and he is living his dream by having his own dance studio and teaching others.

evidence.quote: Yep! Dancing is like second nature to me. I'm living my dream by having my own dance studio and teaching others.
You're living the dream and inspiring others too! Your studio will totally change things for lots of folks.

facts.text: Jon hopes to create a place for people to dance and express themselves, which has been a dream of his.

evidence.quote: I hope so, Gina. I want to create a place for people to dance and express themselves - it's been a dream of mine.
That's a great dream, Jon! Giving people a place to express themselves with dance is really important.

facts.text: Gina believes that Jon's dance studio will make a significant difference and is excited to see it happen.

evidence.quote: Your studio is gonna make a huge difference. Can't wait to see it happen!
